messages.subject: Info: Distance 3.5 Problems, workarounds, and fix timeline
messages.subject_clean: Info: Distance 3.5 Problems, workarounds, and fix timeline
messages.body_plain:
Hi Distance Samplers,

We hope that the 100 or so of you that have downloaded Distance 3.5 so far
are enjoying the new software!

This message is to let you know that we expect to produce an updated release
(Release 4) in a week or two.  It will fix a bug that has just come to light
in the data selection part of the Data Filter (details below).  We will also
try to deal with some other problems, mostly to do with non-English language
setups (see below) at the same time.

If anyone is aware of any other problems/bugs in Release 3 could they please
contact us ASAP so that we can include these in the update.  We do not
anticipate producing many more updates of Distance 3.5 after this one as we
would like to concentrate on the next version of Distance, D4.

Don't forget that an up-to-date list of known problems in Distance 3.5 is
kept on the distance web site http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/

 - Len Thomas

D3.5 New known problems since Release 3 launch (important problem first)
----------------------------------------------

Data Filter: Data Selection does not work correctly when you select
observations based on fields in the observation layer.  In this case,
transects with no observations meeting the selection criteria get dropped
from the analysis, resulting in incorrect assessment of overall effort and
variance. [7 Dec 98]

General: Various problems on computers with non-English international
settings.  Problems include: Error 380 opening example projects, running
analyses or in analysis details.  Error 13 when creating new projects.
Possible work-around is to use English regional settings (choose Regional
Settings in the Windows Control Panel), or at least to ensure that the
decimal place is denoted by a period (.), rather than a comma (,).  Please
let us know if this work-around does not fix your problem. [9 Dec 98]

Data Import: [Unconfirmed problem] Get "Error in Data Import" message when
importing text files generated by MS Excel.  Appears to only occur on some
machines, so one work-around is to try another machine.  We suspect it is an
Excel problem, where on some machines the text file does not have the
appropriate line-termination characters.  Please contact us if you are
experiencing this problem.  Note that the text file should be closed in Excel
before you try to import it in Distance otherwise you will get an error
message. [9 Dec 98]

General: New/Open/Browse/Import file dialogs do not work with some
international character sets (e.g., Japanese), and cause program crash. (This
is a problem with the dialog component) [9 Dec 98]

--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland

messages.subject: Distance 3.5 Import Problems
messages.body_plain:
Distance samplers,

You may remember the post by Pamela McRae on this list about data import a
few weeks ago:

On Wed, 25 Nov 1998 18:04:52 -0500 (EST), Pamela McRae wrote:
> >I was very excited to find out the new version of DISTANCE was available,
> >BUT I am having difficulties importing files which are not already in the
> >old verion but within EXCEL. I am using TAB delimited files, like
> >suggested, but still having problems. Can you Anyone give me a suggestion!
> >
> >Pamela

I followed this up with Pamela by email, and we discovered that it seems to
be a problem with Excel: on some machines Excel's text export produces files
that don't seem to include Carriage Returns (CR) or Line Feeds (LF) at the
end of the lines.  It works fine on our machines here at St Andrews and on
some machines at Pamela's work, but not on others.

If anyone else is having any import problems with data import (using Excel or
any other package) can they please contact me ASAP so that I can have a
chance of finding any bugs in Distance, or can update the Distance help file
to give better instructions, before the next release.

One data import tip that I didn't include in the help file is to make sure
that the text file is closed in your host application (e.g., Excel) before
trying to import it into Distance.

Thanks folks,

 - Len Thomas

--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland

messages.subject: Announcement: Distance 3.5 Release 4 available
messages.body_plain:
Distance samplers,

An updated release of Distance 3.5 is now available for download from the
Distance web site

              http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/

The new release (Release 4) fixes several problems that the developers and
users identified in Release 3 (see below for details).  Because some of these
fixes affect the analysis results, we recommend that all users of release 3
upgrade to the new software.

All the best for the new year,

 - Len Thomas

--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland

Resolved problems / New features in Distance 3.5 Release 4
----------------------------------------------------------

New for Release 4

- Analysis Details: In Log tab, errors and warnings generated during
bootstrapping are treated separately from normal errors and warnings.
- Data Import: Can import data without a stratum layer (i.e., just effort and
observation data).
- Preferences / Analysis Details: New option - can choose either Log or
Results as the default tab when the analysis ran with warnings (amber).
- Preferences / Data Explorer: New option - when copying data sheet to
clipboard, end of lines can be denoted either with Carriage return symbol or
Carriage return + Line feed symbols.

Resolved for Release 4

- Analysis: New analysis engine fails to converge on global maximum with
hazard rate function in cases where it did converge in version 2.2. [10 Dec
98]
- Analysis: Multiplier SE not included correctly when operator is multiply
[17 Dec 98]
- Analysis: Bootstrap by observation only generates internal error [28 Dec
98]
- Analysis: Computing total AIC by stratum when more than one model generates
internal error [28 Dec 98]
- Analysis: Engine can quit when there are very few observations or many
parameters to estimate [28 Dec 98]
- General: Various problems on computers with non-English international
settings, related to differences in formatting of numbers.  Problems include:
(1) error 380 while opening example projects, running analyses or in analysis
details; (2) error 13 while creating new projects; (3) incorrect
interpretation of data inside analysis engine, producing incorrect results;
(4) high-resolution plot files displayed at wrong resolution. [9 Dec 98]
- Analysis Browser: Values in "UCL" (upper confidence limit) columns may not
display correctly (occurs when values are very large, so that they are stored
internally in exponent format). [17 Dec 98] To get the values to display
correctly in Release 4, either re-run the analyses, or use the Column manager
to delete the column(s), close the Column manager, re-open the Column manager
and add the columns back in (this refreshes the column contents).
- Analysis Details: High-resolution plots not displaying properly when left-
truncation used. [16 Dec 98]  If are experiencing this problem and the
analysis was run in releases of Distance < 4 then re-run them in Release 4 to
fix it.
- Data Explorer: Label above the data sheet has a typo: "fieldss from higher
layers". [24 Nov 98]
- Data Explorer: Copy to clipboard does not produce clipboard data that can
be read by all spreadsheets. [9 Dec 98] (See New feature, Preferences / Data
Explorer for fix)
- Data Filter: Data Selection does not work correctly when you select
observations based on fields in the observation layer.  In this case,
transects with no observations meeting the selection criteria get dropped
from the analysis, resulting in incorrect assessment of overall effort and
variance. [7 Dec 98] Fix: re-wrote the data filter routine, and also prevent
selection criteria from spanning data layers using the Or operator.
- Model Definition: Detection function | Adjustment terms tab. Starting
values are ignored when the number of adjustment terms are set to 0, or if
the number of terms is > 0 and the order of terms is not entered. [12 Dec 98]
- Model Definition: When using no stratification or post-stratification
options, the total stratum area doesn't take account of any data selection in
the data filter, so the abundance estimate may be wrong. [23 Nov 98]
- Model Definition: Editing a model definition with smearing enabled causes
an array out of range error. [29 Dec 98]
- New Project Setup Wizard: Hitting enter to move to next page takes you to
the next page whether the current page's entries are valid or not. (Clicking
the next button works, however.) [10 Dec 98]

--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland
